notes.title: [Event] Beat the Dev Win a Steam Key
notes.content:
[h1] Beat the Dev event starting now![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31859798/a33926c22eb84b083d34aacca19c29eace4b0dab.png[/img]

[b]What:[/b]
Win a free Steam Key of Ghost Platoon for your friends.

[b]When:[/b]
Now!

[b]Where:[/b]
Join the Deathmatch-Server called [u][EVENT] Beat the Dev[/u] with the player named [u][Polygon Art][/u] on it.

[b]Rules:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Kill limit: 20
    [*]Time limit: 10min
    [*]Winner is who scores first 20 Kills or who is leading on timeout
    [*]Each player has only one chance
    [*]Steam Key is delivered ingame via chat (screenshot it) after match end and will not be send via mail or private messages afterwards.
[/list]

Scoreboard screenshots of all matches will be attached to this post at the end of the event.

[i]While stocks last, no guarantee for participation. Matches will be recorded and be used for promotional purposes.[/i]
